# Crypto Whale Watch Nexus

> Crypto Whale Watch Nexus is a real-time cryptocurrency analytics platform designed to track, detect, and analyze large whale transactions across multiple blockchains and DEXs (including Hyperliquid).

## Core Capabilities
- Real-time Crypto Whale Transaction Tracking
- Hyperliquid L1 Analytics & Orderbook/Trade Data
- On-chain market intelligence and alerts

## Key Files & Code structure
- `src/lib/hyperliquid.ts`: Integration logic with Hyperliquid API / RPC
- `src/lib/db.ts`: Database integration and schemas for storing whale transactions

## API & Documentation
- Website URL: https://crypto-whale-watch-nexus.lovable.app/
- Repository: https://github.com/gepappas98/crypto-whale-watch-nexus
